description: Recreates the Visual Studio "Find All References" and "Find Results" (Ctrl+Shift+F) windows. Find All References: grouping by project/definition, a multi-column table (Code, File, Line, Column, Project, Containing Member, Containing Type, Kind, Repository), scope and column filters, sorting, kept results and list view.
command.findAllReferences.title: Find All References (VS Style)
command.nextReference.title: Go to Next Reference
command.previousReference.title: Go to Previous Reference
command.findInFiles.title: Find in Files (VS Style)
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (Chinese when VS Code is in Chinese, English otherwise).
config.language: Language of the Find All References window and its messages. Command names and this settings page always follow the VS Code display language.
config.useShiftF12: Open the VS-style Find All References with Shift+F12 (replaces the built-in "Peek References").
config.useCtrlShiftF: Open the VS-style Find Results window with Ctrl+Shift+F (Cmd+Shift+F on macOS), replacing the built-in Search view shortcut.
config.useF4Navigation: Use F4 / Shift+F4 to move to the next / previous result in the most recently used window (Find All References or Find Results).
